title.purpose: Card and screen headings — the typed name on the card.

quantity.purpose: Every ingredient quantity; measurement voice only.

yield.purpose: The 'Makes N' line; the only red-underlined text when scaled.

annotation.purpose: Lineage — variant and parent relations, pencil only.

shadows.name: stacked-card
shadows.purpose: One shadow per card — cards resting on the box interior; offset+blur, never a flat halo.

motion.name: roll-in
motion.purpose: Rolling numerals: scaled quantities update in place, never a jump-cut.

motion.name: recede
motion.purpose: Focus-and-recede: sibling cards dim while a slider drags.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.purpose: Under MediaQuery.disableAnimations, rolls become instant cuts and dims apply instantly.

breakpoints.name: phone-column
breakpoints.value: 480px max width, centered on every surface

narrative.overview: Every recipe is an index card in one family box. The app is a walnut card box holding cream stock: titles are typed in a workmanlike slab, quantities are measurement type, lineage is penciled in handwriting, and a derivative is an annotated copy — stamped VARIANT, never re-typed from scratch. The world lends warmth and material; it never supplies navigation or controls, which stay standard Material 3. Density is ruled-card density: hairline rules every row, one spacing rhythm, no ornaments between the baker and the next number. The aesthetic philosophy is precision without intimidation — pro-grade formula discipline served on home-kitchen card stock.
keyCharacteristics: Walnut ground, cream card faces, one red reserved for meaning
Quantities always in monospace measurement type, never decorative
Stacked-card shadows with offset and blur, like cards resting on cards
Lineage (variants, parents) in handwriting, never in system chrome
No dead controls: every visible control works

rules.name: The Red Reservation Rule
rules.body: Stamp red appears on exactly three things: the VARIANT stamp, a changed yield line, and the 2px lid rule. It never decorates. An idle slider is pencil on rule, not red.

rules.name: The No Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is tinted pencil (warm, hue-derived), never pure gray, on both cream and espresso.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Courier Prime is welded to measurement. Numbers live in the typewriter face; no other element may use it, and no quantity may appear in the system sans.

rules.name: The Two-Hand Rule
rules.body: Names are typed (slab), family history is handwritten (Caveat). A piece of text gets one voice, decided by what it is, not where it sits.

dos: Do keep stamp red for the VARIANT stamp, changed yields, and the lid rule — nothing else.
Do set every quantity in Courier Prime with tabular alignment.
Do render lineage (variant/parent relations) in Caveat pencil.
Do let approximations stay visible: seeds are offered, never imposed.
Do honor Reduce Motion: instant swaps instead of rolls and fades.
donts: Don't ship food photography as layout structure — the box holds cards, not a photo feed.
Don't introduce a second accent color; the system has red and it is scarce.
Don't add dead controls (nav bars, FABs) before the features behind them exist.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't set recipe identity data (steps, dates, lineage) from a scaled recipe instance — those come from the raw card; only quantities scale.
